title: Universal Sacred Stotras & Stuties
summary: Timeless Sanskrit hymns of adoration, meditation, and spiritual invocation composed by classical seers.
ai_summary: A curated anthology of canonical Stotras spanning Gita Dhyanam, Vishnu Sahasranama, Shiva Tandava, Aditya Hridaya, Mahishasura Mardini, Hanuman Chalisa, and Vedic Shanti Mantras.

verses.original: ॐ पार्थाय प्रतिबोधितां भगवता नारायणेन स्वयं व्यासेन ग्रथितां पुराणमुनिना मध्ये महाभारतम् । अद्वैतामृतवर्षिणीं भगवतीमष्टादशाध्यायिनीमम्ब त्वामनुसन्दधामि भगवद्गीते भवद्वेषिणीम् ॥
verses.transliteration: om pārthāya pratibodhitāṁ bhagavatā nārāyaṇena svayaṁ vyāsena grathitāṁ purāṇamuninā madhye mahābhāratam | advaitāmṛtavarṣiṇīṁ bhagavatīmaṣṭādaśādhyāyinīmamba tvāmanusandadhāmi bhagavadgīte bhavadveṣiṇīm ||
verses.translation: Om. O Mother Bhagavad Gita, taught by Bhagavan Narayana Himself to Arjuna, woven into the midst of the Mahabharata by the ancient sage Vyasa, showering the nectar of non-duality, divine goddess of eighteen chapters, dispeller of worldly rebirth — upon You I meditate.

layers.author: madhusudana-saraswati
layers.content: The Gita is addressed as Mother (Amba) who nurtures the spiritual seeker with the nectar of non-dual wisdom (Advaitamrita) and ends the cycles of Samsara.

layers.author: adi-shankara
layers.content: भगवद्गीता माता के समान है जो अद्वैत ज्ञान रूपी अमृत की वर्षा करती है और संसार-दुःख का निवारण करती है।

layers.author: traditional
layers.content: गीतामाता ही अद्वैतामृताची वृष्टी करणारी असून साधकाला भवसागरातून मुक्त करणारी साक्षात भगवंताची वाणी आहे.

verses.original: यं ब्रह्मा वरुणेन्द्ररुद्रमरुतः स्तुन्वन्ति दिव्यैः स्तवैर्वेदैः साङ्गपदक्रमोपनिषदैर्गायन्ति यं सामगाः । ध्यानावस्थिततद्गतेन मनसा पश्यन्ति यं योगिनो यस्यान्तं न विदुः सुरासुरगणा देवाय तस्मै नमः ॥
verses.transliteration: yaṁ brahmā varuṇendrarudramarutaḥ stunvanti divyaiḥ stavairvedaiḥ sāṅgapadakramopaniṣadairgāyanti yaṁ sāmagāḥ | dhyānāvasthitatadgatena manasā paśyanti yaṁ yogino yasyāntaṁ na viduḥ surāsuragaṇā devāya tasmai namaḥ ||
verses.translation: Salutations to that supreme Deity whom Brahma, Varuna, Indra, Rudra, and the Maruts praise with divine hymns; whom the singers of Sama chant through the Vedas with all its limbs, Pada, Krama, and the Upanishads; whom yogis behold with minds absorption-fixed in meditation; and whose infinite bounds neither gods nor demons know.

layers.author: madhusudana-saraswati
layers.content: This verse describes the absolute transcendence of the Supreme Lord, who is simultaneously the subject of Vedic chanting and the goal of Yogic meditation.

layers.author: adi-shankara
layers.content: उस परमेश्वर को प्रणाम है जिसकी महिमा का अंत देवता और असुर भी नहीं जानते, जिसे योगी ध्यान में देखते हैं।

verses.original: शुक्लाम्बरधरं विष्णुं शशिवर्णं चतुर्भुजम् । प्रसन्नवदनं ध्यायेत् सर्वविघ्नोपशान्तये ॥
verses.transliteration: śuklāmbaradharaṁ viṣṇuṁ śaśivarṇaṁ caturbhujam | prasannavadanaṁ dhyāyet sarvavighnopaśāntaye ||
verses.translation: Dressed in white garments, all-pervading, effulgent like the moon, four-armed, with an auspicious radiant countenance — upon Him one should meditate for the cessation of all obstacles.

layers.author: adi-shankara
layers.content: Vishnu signifies the all-pervading reality (Vepana-karma). Contemplating His serene face dissolves internal anxieties and external impediments.

layers.author: adi-shankara
layers.content: सर्वव्यापक, चतुर्भुज, चन्द्रमा के समान कान्तिमान और प्रसन्न मुख वाले भगवान का ध्यान सभी विघ्नों के निवारण हेतु करना चाहिए।

verses.original: शान्ताकारं भुजगशयनं पद्मनाभं सुरेशं विश्वाधारं गगनसदृशं मेघवर्णं शुभाङ्गम् । लक्ष्मीकान्तं कमलनयनं योगिभिर्ध्यानगम्यं वन्दे विष्णुं भवभयहरं सर्वलोकैकनाथम् ॥
verses.transliteration: śāntākāraṁ bhujagaśayanaṁ padmanābhaṁ sureśaṁ viśvādhāraṁ gaganasadṛśaṁ meghavarṇaṁ śubhāṅgam | lakṣmīkāntaṁ kamalanayanaṁ yogibhirdhyānagamyaṁ vande viṣṇuṁ bhavabhayaharaṁ sarvalokaikanātham ||
verses.translation: I bow to Vishnu, of serene form, reclining on the serpent Ananta, with a lotus emerging from His navel, Lord of the devas, the support of the universe, boundless like the sky, cloud-hued, of auspicious limbs, beloved of Lakshmi, lotus-eyed, attainable through meditation by yogis, who dispels the fear of worldly existence and is the sole sovereign of all realms.

layers.author: sridhara-swami
layers.content: Reclining on the serpent of infinite time while remaining utterly serene symbolizes transcendence over cosmic turmoil.

layers.author: traditional
layers.content: परम शांत स्वरूप, शेषनाग पर शयन करने वाले, समस्त लोकों के स्वामी भगवान विष्णु जन्म-मृत्यु के भय को हरने वाले हैं।

verses.original: जटाटवीगलज्जलप्रवाहपावितस्थले गलेऽवलम्ब्य लम्बितां भुजङ्गतुङ्गमालिकाम् । डमड्डमड्डमड्डमन्निनादवड्डमर्वयं चकार चण्डताण्डवं तनोतु नः शिवः शिवम् ॥
verses.transliteration: jaṭāṭavīgalajjala-pravāha-pāvitasthale gale'valambya lambitāṁ bhujaṅga-tuṅga-mālikām | ḍamaḍ-ḍamaḍ-ḍamaḍ-ḍaman-ninādavad-ḍamarvayaṁ cakāra caṇḍa-tāṇḍavaṁ tanotu naḥ śivaḥ śivam ||
verses.translation: With His forest of matted locks purified by the cascading waters of the celestial Ganga, with a lofty garland of serpents draped around His neck, and sounding His damaru drum with the rhythmic beats 'damat-damat-damat-damat', Lord Shiva performed His fierce Tandava dance; may He expand auspiciousness and bliss for us all.

layers.author: traditional
layers.content: The Shiva Tandava Stotram captures Spanda — the cosmic pulsating vibration of Shiva through alliterative rhythm and sublime cadence.

layers.author: traditional
layers.content: गंगा की पवित्र धाराओं से सुशोभित जटाओं वाले और डमरू के नाद पर ताण्डव करने वाले भगवान शिव हमारा कल्याण करें।

verses.original: करचरणकृतं वाक्कायजं कर्मजं वा श्रवणनयनजं वा मानसं वापराधम् । विहितमविहितं वा सर्वमेतत्क्षमस्व जय जय करुणाब्धे श्रीमहादेव शम्भो ॥
verses.transliteration: karacaraṇakṛtaṁ vākkāyajaṁ karmajaṁ vā śravaṇanayanajaṁ vā mānasaṁ vāparādham | vihitamavihitaṁ vā sarvametatkṣamasva jaya jaya karuṇābdhe śrīmahādeva śambho ||
verses.translation: Whatever fault or offense committed by my hands, feet, speech, body, actions, ears, eyes, or mind — whether enjoined or prohibited — forgive it all, O Ocean of Compassion, glory unto You, O Mahadeva, O Shambhu!

layers.author: adi-shankara
layers.content: A supreme prayer of total surrender, seeking forgiveness for conscious and unconscious errors across thought, word, and deed.

layers.author: adi-shankara
layers.content: हाथ, पैर, वाणी, शरीर, नेत्र, कान या मन से हुए समस्त अपराधों को क्षमा करें, हे करुणा के सागर महादेव!

verses.original: ततो युद्धपरिश्रान्तं समरे चिन्तया स्थितम् । रावणं चाग्रतो दृष्ट्वा युद्धाय समुपस्थितम् ॥ दैवतैश्च समागम्य द्रष्टुमभ्यागतो रणम् । उपगम्याब्रवीद्राममगस्त्यो भगवानृषिः ॥
verses.transliteration: tato yuddhapariśrāntaṁ samare cintayā sthitam | rāvaṇaṁ cāgrato dṛṣṭvā yuddhāya samupasthitam || daivataiśca samāgamya draṣṭumabhyāgato raṇam | upagamyābravīdrāmamagastyo bhagavānṛṣiḥ ||
verses.translation: Beholding Rama fatigued by the battle and standing thoughtful on the field, with Ravana in front ready for combat, the venerable sage Agastya, who had arrived with the gods to witness the conflict, approached Rama and spoke.

layers.author: valmiki
layers.content: The preamble to the Aditya Hridaya Stotram, imparted by sage Agastya to Sri Rama on the battlefield to invoke solar energy and vanquish Ravana.

layers.author: govindaraja
layers.content: युद्ध से थके हुए श्रीराम को देखकर महर्षि अगस्त्य ने रावण पर विजय प्राप्त करने हेतु इस आदित्य हृदय स्तोत्र का उपदेश दिया।

verses.original: आदित्यहृदयं पुण्यं सर्वशत्रुविनाशनम् । जयावहं जपेन्नित्यमक्षय्यं परमं शिवम् ॥
verses.transliteration: ādityahṛdayaṁ puṇyaṁ sarvaśatruvināśanam | jayāvahaṁ japennityamakṣayyaṁ paramaṁ śivam ||
verses.translation: This Aditya Hridaya is holy, the destroyer of all adversaries, bringing total victory; recite it perpetually, for it bestows imperishable and supreme auspiciousness.

layers.author: valmiki
layers.content: The sun is the dispeller of inner and outer darkness. Chanting this hymn awakens boundless prana and moral fortitude.

layers.author: rama-tilaka
layers.content: आदित्य हृदय स्तोत्र समस्त शत्रुओं का नाश करने वाला, विजय प्रदायक तथा अक्षय कल्याणकारी है।

verses.original: अयि गिरिनन्दिनि नन्दितमेदिनि विश्वविनोदिनि नन्दसुते गिरिवरविन्ध्यशिरोऽधिनिवासिनि विष्णुविलासिनि जिष्णुनुते । भगवति हे शितिकण्ठकुटुम्बिनि भूरिकुटुम्बिनि भूरिकृते जय जय हे महिषासुरमर्दिनि रम्यकपर्दिनि शैलसुते ॥
verses.transliteration: ayi girinandini nanditamedini viśvavinodini nandasute girivaravindhyaśiro'dhinivāsini viṣṇuvilāsini jiṣṇunute | bhagavati he śitikaṇṭhakuṭumbini bhūrikuṭumbini bhūrikṛte jaya jaya he mahiṣāsuramardini ramyakapardini śailasute ||
verses.translation: O daughter of the Mountain, who gladdens the earth, delights the cosmos, daughter of Nanda, dwelling on the high peaks of the Vindhya mountains, delighting Vishnu, praised by Indra! O divine Goddess, consort of blue-throated Shiva, mother of the universal family, creator of abundance! Victory, victory to You, O slayer of Mahishasura, with charming braided tresses, O daughter of the Mountain!

layers.author: adi-shankara
layers.content: Celebrates the supreme Mother of the cosmos who destroys the demon of ego and spiritual darkness (Mahishasura).

layers.author: adi-shankara
layers.content: पर्वतराज पुत्री, विन्ध्याचल निवासिनी, महिषासुर का संहार करने वाली माँ जगदम्बा की सदा जय हो।

verses.original: सुरवरवर्षिणि दुर्धरधर्षिणि दुर्मुखमर्षिणि हर्षरते त्रिभुवनपोषिणि शङ्करतोषिणि किल्बिषमोषिणि घोषरते । दनुजनिरोषिणि दितिसुतरोषिणि दुर्मदशोषिणि सिन्धुसुते जय जय हे महिषासुरमर्दिनि रम्यकपर्दिनि शैलसुते ॥
verses.transliteration: suravaravarṣiṇi durdharadharṣiṇi durmukhamarṣiṇi harṣarate tribhuvanapoṣiṇi śaṅkaratoṣiṇi kilbiṣamoṣiṇi ghoṣarate | danujaniroṣiṇi ditisutaroṣiṇi durmadaśoṣiṇi sindhusute jaya jaya he mahiṣāsuramardini ramyakapardini śailasute ||
verses.translation: Bestowing boons upon the gods, subduing the unruly, punishing the wicked Durmukha, rejoicing in joy, nourishing the three worlds, delighting Shiva, removing all sins, rejoicing in sacred chants! Drying up insolence, daughter of the ocean! Victory, victory to You, O slayer of Mahishasura, with charming braided tresses, daughter of the Mountain!

layers.author: adi-shankara
layers.content: The mother power purifies vices (kilbisha-moshini) and nourishes the three worlds of experience.

layers.author: traditional
layers.content: देवताओं को वरदान देने वाली, त्रिभुवन का पोषण करने वाली और पापों को हरने वाली देवी को बारंबार नमन।

verses.original: मनोजवं मारुततुल्यवेगं जितेन्द्रियं बुद्धिमतां वरिष्ठम् । वातात्मजं वानरयूथमुख्यं श्रीरामदूतं शरणं प्रपद्ये ॥
verses.transliteration: manojavaṁ mārutatulyavegaṁ jitendriyaṁ buddhimatāṁ variṣṭham | vātātmajaṁ vānarayūthamukhyaṁ śrīrāmadūtaṁ śaraṇaṁ prapadye ||
verses.translation: Swift as the mind, with speed equal to the wind, master of the senses, foremost among the wise, son of the wind-god, chief of the vanara hosts, envoy of Sri Rama — at his feet I seek refuge.

layers.author: traditional
layers.content: Highlights the synthesis of unmatched physical prowess (Marutatulyavegam) and supreme intellectual mastery (Buddhimatam varishtham).

layers.author: tulsidas
layers.content: मन के समान वेग वाले, इन्द्रियों को जीतने वाले, बुद्धिमानों में श्रेष्ठ, पवनपुत्र श्रीरामदूत हनुमान जी की मैं शरण लेता हूँ।

verses.original: बुद्धिर्बलं यशो धैर्यं निर्भयत्वमरोगता । अजाड्यं वाक्पटुत्वं च हनुमत्स्मरणाद्भवेत् ॥
verses.transliteration: buddhirbalaṁ yaśo dhairyaṁ nirbhayatvamarogatā | ajāḍyaṁ vākpaṭutvaṁ ca hanumatsmaraṇādbhavet ||
verses.translation: Wisdom, physical vigor, renown, patience, fearlessness, health, alertness of mind, and eloquence of speech — all these are attained through the remembrance of Hanuman.

layers.author: traditional
layers.content: Remembrance of Hanuman brings eight essential human virtues needed for triumphant worldly and spiritual life.

layers.author: tulsidas
layers.content: हनुमान जी के स्मरण मात्र से बुद्धि, बल, कीर्ति, धैर्य, निर्भयता, स्वास्थ्य और वाक्पटुता प्राप्त होती है।

verses.original: जय हनुमान ज्ञान गुन सागर । जय कपीस तिहुँ लोक उजागर ॥ राम दूत अतुलित बल धामा । अञ्जनि पुत्र पवनसुत नामा ॥
verses.transliteration: jaya hanumāna jñāna guna sāgara | jaya kapīsa tihuom loka ujāgara || rāma dūta atulita bala dhāmā | añjani putra pavanasuta nāmā ||
verses.translation: Hail Hanuman, ocean of divine wisdom and virtue! Hail Lord of Monkeys, illuminator of the three worlds! Messenger of Rama, reservoir of incomparable strength, son of Anjani, known as Pavanasuta (son of the Wind).

layers.author: tulsidas
layers.content: The opening chaupais of the Hanuman Chalisa synthesize devotion, strength, and enlightened wisdom.

layers.author: tulsidas
layers.content: हे हनुमान जी, आप ज्ञान और गुणों के सागर हैं, तीनों लोकों को प्रकाशित करने वाले, अतुलित बल के धाम हैं।

verses.original: महाबीर बिक्रम बजरङ्गी । कुमति निवार सुमति के सङ्गी ॥ कञ्चन बरन बिराज सुबेसा । कानन कुण्डल कुञ्चित केसा ॥
verses.transliteration: mahābīra bikrama bajaraṅgī | kumati nivāra sumati ke saṅgī || kañcana barana birāja subesā | kānana kuṇḍala kuñcita kesā ||
verses.translation: Great hero, endowed with thunderbolt-like limbs, dispeller of wicked intellect and companion of enlightened wisdom! Radiant with golden complexion, splendidly attired, wearing ear-pendants and having curled dark tresses.

layers.author: tulsidas
layers.content: True strength (Bajrangi) is that which destroys negative mental tendencies (Kumati nivara) and establishes pure intelligence (Sumati ke sangi).

layers.author: tulsidas
layers.content: वज्र के समान अंगों वाले वीर हनुमान दुर्बुद्धि को दूर कर सुबुद्धि प्रदान करते हैं।

verses.original: ॐ पूर्णमदः पूर्णमिदं पूर्णात्पूर्णमुदच्यते । पूर्णस्य पूर्णमादाय पूर्णमेवावशिष्यते ॥ ॐ शान्तिः शान्तिः शान्तिः ॥
verses.transliteration: om pūrṇamadaḥ pūrṇamidaṁ pūrṇātpūrṇamudacyate | pūrṇasya pūrṇamādāya pūrṇamevāvaśiṣyate || om śāntiḥ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ ||
verses.translation: Om. That (Unmanifest Brahman) is Infinite; this (Manifest cosmos) is Infinite. From the Infinite the Infinite emerges. Taking the Infinite from the Infinite, the Infinite alone remains. Om Peace, Peace, Peace.

layers.author: adi-shankara
layers.content: The foundational mathematical and metaphysical paradox of Vedanta: Brahman is non-diminishing fullness.

layers.author: adi-shankara
layers.content: वह परब्रह्म पूर्ण है, यह जगत भी पूर्ण है। पूर्ण में से पूर्ण निकालने पर भी पूर्ण ही शेष रहता है।

verses.original: ॐ सह नाववतु । सह नौ भुनक्तु । सह वीर्यं करवावहै । तेजस्वि नावधीतमस्तु मा विद्विषावहै ॥ ॐ शान्तिः शान्तिः शान्तिः ॥
verses.transliteration: om saha nāvavatu | saha nau bhunaktu | saha vīryaṁ karavāvahai | tejasvi nāvadhītamastu mā vidviṣāvahai || om śāntiḥ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ ||
verses.translation: Om. May the Divine protect us both (teacher and disciple). May the Divine nourish us both. May we work together with great energy. May our study be vigorous and illuminating. May we never harbor animosity between us. Om Peace, Peace, Peace.

layers.author: adi-shankara
layers.content: The sacred covenant of education: learning flourishes when teacher and student share mutual reverence and united focus.

layers.author: traditional
layers.content: परमेश्वर हम दोनों (गुरु और शिष्य) की रक्षा करें, हम साथ-साथ विद्या अध्ययन करें और कभी परस्पर द्वेष न करें।

verses.original: ॐ असतो मा सद्गमय । तमसो मा ज्योतिर्गमय । मृत्योर्मा अमृतं गमय ॥ ॐ शान्तिः शान्तिः शान्तिः ॥
verses.transliteration: om asato mā sadgamaya | tamaso mā jyotirgamaya | mṛtyormā amṛtaṁ gamaya || om śāntiḥ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ ||
verses.translation: Om. Lead me from the unreal to the Real. Lead me from darkness to Light. Lead me from death to Immortality. Om Peace, Peace, Peace.

layers.author: adi-shankara
layers.content: The three ascending steps of human aspiration: discerning Truth, attaining Illumination, and realizing eternal Consciousness.

layers.author: adi-shankara
layers.content: हमें असत्य से सत्य की ओर ले चलें, अज्ञान के अंधकार से ज्ञान के प्रकाश की ओर और मृत्यु से अमरता की ओर ले चलें।

verses.original: ॐ सर्वे भवन्तु सुखिनः सर्वे सन्तु निरामयाः । सर्वे भद्राणि पश्यन्तु मा कश्चिद्दुःखभाग्भवेत् ॥ ॐ शान्तिः शान्तिः शान्तिः ॥
verses.transliteration: om sarve bhavantu sukhinaḥ sarve santu nirāmayāḥ | sarve bhadrāṇi paśyantu mā kaścidduḥkhabhāgbhavet || om śāntiḥ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ ||
verses.translation: Om. May all beings be happy. May all beings be free from illness. May all perceive what is auspicious and good. May no one suffer distress or grief. Om Peace, Peace, Peace.

layers.author: traditional
layers.content: The epitome of Vedic universal goodwill, extending boundless compassion to all living creatures without distinction.

layers.author: traditional
layers.content: सभी सुखी हों, सभी रोगमुक्त हों, सभी का कल्याण हो और किसी को भी दुःख का भागी न बनना पड़े।

verses.original: कराग्रे वसते लक्ष्मीः करमध्ये सरस्वती । करमूले तु गोविन्दः प्रभाते करदर्शनम् ॥
verses.transliteration: karāgre vasate lakṣmīḥ karamadhye sarasvatī | karamūle tu govindaḥ prabhāte karadarśanam ||
verses.translation: At the tips of the fingers resides Lakshmi; in the center of the palm resides Saraswati; at the base of the hand resides Govinda. Thus, one should look at one's palms upon waking in the morning.

layers.author: traditional
layers.content: Morning palm-contemplation infuses daily human labor with divine purpose: wealth (Lakshmi), wisdom (Saraswati), and righteous sustenance (Govinda).

layers.author: traditional
layers.content: हाथ के अग्रभाग में लक्ष्मी, मध्य में सरस्वती और मूल में भगवान गोविन्द का वास है, अतः प्रातःकाल अपनी हथेलियों का दर्शन करना चाहिए।

verses.original: समुद्रवसने देवि पर्वतस्तनमण्डले । विष्णुपत्नि नमस्तुभ्यं पादस्पर्शं क्षमस्व मे ॥
verses.transliteration: samudravasane devi parvatastanamaṇḍale | viṣṇupatni namastubhyaṁ pādasparśaṁ kṣamasva me ||
verses.translation: O Goddess Earth, clothed by the oceans, adorned with mountains, consort of Vishnu! Salutations unto You; forgive me for touching You with my feet as I step upon the ground.

layers.author: traditional
layers.content: Vedic ecological reverence: acknowledging the sacred earth as a living mother before setting foot upon her soil each day.

layers.author: traditional
layers.content: हे समुद्र रूपी वस्त्र धारण करने वाली, पर्वतों से सुशोभित पृथ्वी माता! भगवान विष्णु की भार्या, मेरे पैरों के स्पर्श को क्षमा करें।
